items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Hugh Brodie is going to play jazz on the courthouse steps...

ctx.x: Hugh Brodie is going to play jazz on the courthouse steps, for the art show, for the open air art exhibit on the courthouse lawn a week from Saturday, and we got word that the union is going to pay for the musicians, they're gonna give them the money to do it, see, and they're going to play for two hours, from two to four, a week from Saturday.
That's going to be like a warmup, and they'll be saying things like, 'Who is J.C. Johnson?' -- stuff like that.
